required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Application cover sheet for Joint Center of Excellence for Advanced Materials Research submitted via Grants.gov workspace (FAA-COE-JAMS).

required_documents.name: Project Narrative / Scope of Work
required_documents.details: Detailed project narrative addressing goals, methodology, timeline, and measurable outcomes for Joint Center of Excellence for Advanced Materials Research.

required_documents.name: SF-424A Budget Information and Budget Narrative
required_documents.details: Itemized budget and cost justification covering direct costs, personnel, and operations for Joint Center of Excellence for Advanced Materials Research.

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary
required_documents.details: Public summary abstract outlining project objectives, scope, and anticipated community impact for Joint Center of Excellence for Advanced Materials Research.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support and Collaboration
required_documents.details: Letters of support or commitment from cooperating partners, local stakeholders, or participating institutions for Joint Center of Excellence for Advanced Materials Research.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Grants.gov Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and Grants.gov credentials.

eligibility.summary: Member universities of the COE can apply. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: Non-federal cost sharing or matching is required under this program.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity FAA-COE-JAMS.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
